# AI Image Generation

Generate and edit images on RunComfy through one CLI, as a smart router across 11 or more image models, for both text-to-image and image-to-image. It covers FLUX 2 Klein 9B and 4B, FLUX 2 Pro, Dev, Flash, Turbo and Max, Google Nano Banana 2 and Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream 5, 4-5 and Dreamina 4-0, Alibaba Qwen Image and Z-Image Turbo, and Wan 2-7, plus edit endpoints such as Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit and FLUX Kontext Pro. It picks by intent: GPT Image 2 for in-image text, Seedream for photoreal portraits, Klein 4B or Nano Banana 2 for fast iteration, and multi-reference models for brand styling. Nano Banana can optionally use web search grounding, at extra cost. Every run is charged by RunComfy.
